text.en: 1. This Notification is the Human Organ Transplant (Declaration of Hospitals) (Consolidation) Notification 2025.

2. The Minister declares —
(a)the hospitals specified in the first column of Part 1 of the Schedule to be hospitals for the purposes of the Act other than Part 4A with effect from the date specified in the second column; and
(b)the hospitals specified in the first column of Part 2 of the Schedule to be hospitals for the purposes of Part 4A of the Act with effect from the date specified in the second column.
